## Summary

**LOAD** (Load source into register): Load 64 bit into destination register.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `<vea> → d` |
| Syntax | `LOAD <vea>,d` |
| Short | Load 64 bit into destination register. |
| Description | Load is the AMMX equivalent of move &lt;ea&gt;,dn |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | `0` |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | `0000` |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00000001` |

- Load is always quad word.
- Immediate data can be word size, this will expand repeated to quad .

### Example

```asm
    load.w    #$1234,d1
```

```text
Result:
d d1: 12 34 12 34 12 34 12 34
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no LOAD. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
